newsitem.title: USA: Ackerley Q2 sales $77.2 mln, up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Ackerley Q2 sales $77.2 mln, up slightly.

text.p: Ackerley Group Inc said Wednesday second quarter revenues rose slightly from a year ago to $77.2 million.
Revenue for the first six months totaled $156.5 million, an increase of 7 percent over the comparable period in 1996, it said.
The company said out-of-home and broadcasting divisions showed strong revenue growth for the quarter of 9 percent and 6 percent, respectively.

Revenue for the Sports and Entertainment division decreased due to the Seattle SuperSonics second round exit from the National Basketball Association play-offs, it said. A year ago the Sonics advanced to the NBA finals, which generated significant revenue for the company.
